title: 12 Words My AI Team
Will <g>Never</g> Write
subtitle: They're banned in the rules. Every draft is checked for them.

cards.title: Leverage
cards.body: Say what you'll use, and for what.

cards.title: Unlock
cards.body: Nothing was locked. Name the result.

cards.title: Seamless
cards.body: Every handover has a seam. Show it.

cards.title: Basically
cards.body: If it's basic, skip the word.

cards.title: To be honest
cards.body: Everything else should be honest too.

cards.title: Long dashes
cards.body: A comma or a full stop does the job.
